content.name: Marc-Antoine Bélanger
content.title: Talent Acquisition Manager, CRHA
content.summary: Bilingual talent acquisition leader and CRHA with 15 years in RPO, video games and aerospace. Leads a team of eight recruiters filling about 400 roles a year across Québec and Ontario, and cut cost per hire by 29% after taking agency hiring in-house.

experience.title: Talent Acquisition Manager
bullets: Lead eight recruiters and coordinators hiring about 400 engineers, machinists and assemblers a year across three plants.
Took most agency hiring in-house and cut cost per hire by 29% in two years.
Launched a trades pipeline with two CEGEPs and a vocational school, filling 60 machinist roles from graduating classes.
Ensure job postings and processes meet Québec's Charter of the French Language requirements and pay equity obligations.
Report quarterly hiring forecasts and funnel metrics to the VP Human Resources.

experience.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
bullets: Hired artists, programmers and producers for a 900-person game studio, including 70 international hires.
Coordinated work permits through the Québec Acceptance Certificate and LMIA processes with immigration counsel.
Built a campus program with three universities that supplied 35% of junior hires.
Introduced structured interview guides that reduced early regretted attrition.

experience.title: Recruitment Consultant
bullets: Recruited for banking and insurance clients in an RPO model, filling about 120 roles a year.
Ran bilingual high-volume hiring days for contact centres, hiring 200 agents in a single quarter.
Mentored three new recruiters on sourcing and client intake meetings.
